<observations>
Date: Mar 11, 2026
* 🔴 User preferences: PostgreSQL backend, TypeScript with strict linting, monthly cloud budget capped at $1,850. User has a cat named Pixel.
* 🔴 User decided to defer recurring invoices until after beta.
* ✅ (10:30) Agent fixed a null reference error in `src/invoice/pdfGenerator.ts` and verified tests passed.

Date: Mar 14, 2026
* 🔴 User set public launch date to April 23, 2026 and requested all env vars be prefixed with `LEDGERLY_`.
* 🔴 User requested webhook support for payment events and scheduled a Stripe demo with marketing.
* ✅ (16:55) Agent added Stripe webhook handler with signature validation, updated CI, refactored env vars, and merged feature/webhook-support PR.

Date: Mar 17, 2026
* 🔴 User asked about exponential backoff for failed webhook retries and requested Winston logging prefixed with `LEDGERLY_`.
* ✅ (21:20) Agent implemented exponential backoff retry logic in `src/utils/retry.ts`, enforced 95% test coverage, and fixed a flaky mock test.
* ✅ (22:00) Agent configured Winston logger (`LEDGERLY_LOG_LEVEL`), wrapped webhook handler with logging, and merged PR.

Date: Mar 20, 2026
* 🔴 User stated Ledgerly must support EUR and GBP alongside USD. Public launch date updated to May 10, 2026 due to payments audit.
* 🔴 User asked whether email templates should be repo-stored or CDN-fetched.
* ✅ (20:45) Agent added multi-currency support (`src/models/Currency.ts`), PDF rendering, SendGrid email service (`src/utils/email.ts`), and deployed a staging build.

Date: Mar 24, 2026
* 🔴 User requested OAuth login via Google and GitHub, and asked about data export formats (CSV/Excel/JSON).
* ✅ (09:55) Agent implemented Passport OAuth middleware for Google/GitHub and merged PR.
* ✅ (13:05) Agent scaffolded React analytics component, integrated chart.js, added CSV export endpoint (`/api/export/csv`), and set up automated nightly AWS S3 backups.

Date: Mar 28, 2026
* 🔴 Standing rule: Never push directly to `main`, always open a pull request.
* 🔴 User asked if Stripe or PayPal should be primary payment processor, and requested a monthly revenue summary broken down by client tier.
* 🟡 (15:40) Agent added “useStripe” feature toggle in `config/featureFlags.ts`.
* 🟡 (18:25) Agent added tiered revenue query in `src/queries/revenueByTier.sql`.
* ✅ (19:20) Agent refactored invoice rendering (`src/services/invoiceRenderer.ts`), added `/api/invoice/pdf` endpoint, and deployed latest build to staging instance `ledgerly-stg-01`.
</observations>

<suggested-response>
The assistant should wait for the user to provide the next instruction or feedback on the staging deployment and tiered revenue report.
</suggested-response>
